text: Eli?
The thing inside Eli's barn knew his name.
It was Mara, his neighbor from Two Farms East.
She crossed three miles of fields and her jacket was covered in blood.
Don't come closer.
I'm not bitten.
Look.
Eli kept his distance.
Another survivor can save your life.
or end it.
So before she came any closer, Eli checked for bites.
Nothing.
It's not my blood.
Then Mara told him the blood wasn't hers.
Her truck died when the roads jammed.
She ran through the fields and followed the only sound she could hear: Eli's generator.
I heard your generator.
So did they.
Mara wasn't the only one following it.
For 10 minutes, that engine had been telling everything in the woods where the farm was.
Eli killed it.
Silence.
but you can't take noise back.
Then Mara gave him worse news.
Eli
I didn't use the gate.
There's a break by the creek.
There was a break in the west fence.
Rusty was already staring toward it.
Before Eli could reach the fence, something stood up in the grass.
One infected was already inside.
Then Eli looked beyond it.
It's not all of them.
The farm wasn't hidden anymore, and it was far too big to defend.
